adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
adds.text: With Izel loose in the Lighthouse, Mack and Daisy prove who they are by sharing a secret only they know, and Mack locks Daisy away to keep Izel from taking her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Mack locks away to keep Izel from taking her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who locks Daisy away to keep Izel out.
adds.evidence: Leap (S6E10): Mack and Johnson are cleared when Mack says Johnson sends part of her salary to Amanda Campbell; Mack then locks Johnson and Rodriguez in a room so the strongest can't be possessed.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
adds.text: Enoch readies a Life Model Decoy of Coulson and leaves its start button for Mack and Daisy, then steps out to let them switch it on.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The Chronicom who readies Coulson's LMD for Mack.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Enoch leaves Coulson's LMD with to switch on.
adds.evidence: New Life (S6E13) per Enoch's page: after the jump to 1931, Enoch dressed the Coulson LMD to be booted by Daisy and Mackenzie, put the start button on a table and left the room (cited AoS613).

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
adds.text: Flint turns up at Izel's temple, where Mack is chained, and tries to fight her. Once Deke frees them, Mack gets the hurt Flint to the Zephyr and leaves him with Piper.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A young Inhuman Mack gets out of Izel's temple.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who gets Flint out of Izel's temple.
adds.evidence: The Sign (S6E12): Flint finds Mackenzie and Yo-Yo handcuffed by Izel and attacks her; Izel injures him; Deke frees Yo-Yo, Mack and Flint, who reach the Zephyr, where Flint is left in Piper's care.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
adds.text: Jemma presents Mack with a Life Model Decoy of Coulson, built to be his right hand, and Mack hesitates before it is switched on.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's friend, back as an LMD built to be his right hand.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's friend, who hesitates before the LMD is switched on.
adds.evidence: New Life (S6E13): Simmons reveals a Coulson LMD made with Enoch, 'no better person to be your right hand, sir' (to Mackenzie); it is activated by Quake despite Mackenzie's hesitation.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
adds.text: Trapped with Deke in Sarge's truck as it speeds toward the Shrike tower, Daisy uses her powers to shield the bomb he cannot defuse.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate whose bomb Daisy shields when he can't defuse it.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who shields the bomb Deke can't defuse.
adds.evidence: Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): Johnson, May, Shaw and Snowflake are trapped with the atom bomb; Shaw cannot defuse it and Johnson uses her powers to protect it from the collision.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
adds.text: Mack locks Daisy and Yo-Yo away together to keep Izel out of them. When they confront Izel, Yo-Yo lets Izel take her body.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend locked away with Daisy, who lets Izel take her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend locked away with Yo-Yo to keep Izel out.
adds.evidence: Leap (S6E10): Mack locks Johnson and Rodriguez in a room; Izel later finds Rodriguez and Johnson helping Mack and takes over Rodriguez (Wikipedia: Yo-Yo allows herself to be possessed).

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#5
adds.text: When Atarah's Chronicoms capture Daisy's team, Enoch tells Atarah to put Jemma in danger to make Fitz help, and a horrified Daisy fights her way out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A Chronicom friend who sells out Daisy's team to Atarah.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Enoch sells out to Atarah, who fights her way out.
adds.evidence: The Other Thing (S6E5): Enoch reveals that putting Simmons in danger would motivate Fitz; Johnson and Simmons are appalled by his betrayal; Johnson quakes Atarah and they flee.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#5
adds.text: In deep space, captured by the Chronicoms, Jemma gives herself up so that Daisy and the others can escape home to Earth.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's best friend, who gives herself up so Daisy can escape.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jemma's best friend, whom she gives herself up to save.
adds.evidence: The Other Thing (S6E5): Simmons surrenders to the Chronicoms in order to reunite with Fitz and so Daisy and her team can return to Earth.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#11
adds.text: Daisy confronts May over how she questions Sarge, and later May visits Daisy, who is now sure Sarge will help them if they trust him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's trainer, whose questioning of Sarge she challenges.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: May's trainee, who challenges her over Sarge.
adds.evidence: From the Ashes (S6E11): Johnson confronts May, criticizing her interrogation of Sarge; May later visits Johnson, who voices her confidence Sarge will help.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
adds.text: Jemma reveals a Life Model Decoy of Coulson, and Daisy is the one who switches it on.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's father figure, back as an LMD she switches on.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit, who switches on his LMD.
adds.evidence: New Life (S6E13): the Coulson LMD 'is activated by Quake despite Mackenzie's hesitation'. (Earlier in From the Ashes, S6E11, Daisy reads the letter Coulson left her.)

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
adds.text: Davis and Yo-Yo take a Quinjet with Mack and Jaco to board Izel's ship and rescue Fitz and Simmons.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate on the raid on Izel's ship.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who flies the raid on Izel's ship with Elena.
adds.evidence: Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): Mackenzie, Rodriguez, Davis and Jaco take the Quinjet to infiltrate the Lazy Comet and rescue Fitz and Simmons.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
adds.text: Deke jumps into Izel's temple and gives Yo-Yo a sonic cuff so she can break free.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Deke frees from Izel's temple.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who frees Elena from Izel's temple.
adds.evidence: The Sign (S6E12): Shaw gives Rodriguez, Mackenzie and Flint the Sonic Barrier Cuffs, enabling them to escape from Izel.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#8
adds.text: Deke rides in Sarge's truck with May and Daisy toward the Shrike tower, and when they find Sarge's bomb, they count on him to defuse it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who counts on Deke to defuse Sarge's bomb.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate May counts on to defuse Sarge's bomb.
adds.evidence: Collision Course Part One (S6E8): Shaw joins May and Johnson in Sarge's truck; Johnson, May, Shaw and Snowflake find the bomb, counting on Shaw to dismantle it.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
adds.text: Deke catches Piper carrying a Shrike crystal, and Izel leaves Piper's body and takes his. Both black out, and each names the other as the last person seen.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Izel jumps from into Deke.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Izel jumps into from Piper.
adds.evidence: Leap (S6E10): Shaw catches Piper with the Shrike crystal; Izel comes out of Piper and possesses Shaw; Piper says when she woke Deke was there, and Shaw says the last thing he saw was Piper.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
adds.text: Flint turns up at Izel's temple, where Yo-Yo is chained, and tries to fight her. Once they are freed, Yo-Yo gets the hurt Flint to the Zephyr and leaves him with Piper.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A young Inhuman Yo-Yo gets out of Izel's temple.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who gets Flint out of Izel's temple.
adds.evidence: The Sign (S6E12): Flint finds Mackenzie and Yo-Yo handcuffed by Izel and attacks her; Deke frees them; they reach the Zephyr and Flint is left in Piper's care.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
adds.text: Yo-Yo and Mack board Izel's ship and find Jemma and Fitz in hiding, then escape with them back to Earth.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Yo-Yo rescues from Izel's ship.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who rescues Jemma from Izel's ship.
adds.evidence: Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): Rodriguez and Mackenzie find Fitz and Simmons on the Lazy Comet; Jaco's portal brings them all back to Earth.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
adds.text: Yo-Yo and Mack board Izel's ship and find Fitz and Jemma in hiding, then escape with them back to Earth.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Yo-Yo rescues from Izel's ship.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who rescues Fitz from Izel's ship.
adds.evidence: Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): Rodriguez and Mackenzie find Fitz and Simmons on the Lazy Comet; Jaco's portal brings them all back to Earth.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
adds.text: At the victory party, Yo-Yo and May talk about how troubled they are that Sarge looks exactly like Coulson.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Yo-Yo confides in about Sarge's face.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who shares May's unease about Sarge's face.
adds.evidence: Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): at the Lighthouse celebration Rodriguez and May discuss how they were troubled by Sarge looking exactly like Coulson. (They also lead the jewelry-store raid together in S6E2.)

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
adds.text: After escaping Izel's temple, Yo-Yo and Mack leave the hurt Flint with Piper on the Zephyr, and Piper tells them Sarge has arrived.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Yo-Yo leaves Flint with on the Zephyr.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who leaves Flint in Piper's care.
adds.evidence: The Sign (S6E12): Flint is left in the care of Piper, who informs Mackenzie that Sarge has arrived; Wikipedia: Mack and Yo-Yo have Piper fly Flint to safety.

owner_calls.question: Should the Phil Coulson file count the Chronicom LMD switched on at the end of S6E13 (Daisy and Mack stages proposed there)?
options: Yes, keep the S6#13 stages for Mack and Daisy
No, the LMD is a separate person; drop those two adds
owner_calls.evidence: New Life (S6E13): Simmons reveals a Chronicom-tech Coulson LMD, activated by Quake despite Mack's hesitation.

owner_calls.question: The Flint at Izel's temple in S6E11-12 is a Monolith-made recreation of the 2091 Flint. Count him as the same Flint (Mack and Yo-Yo stages at S6#12)?
options: No, drop the two Flint adds
owner_calls.evidence: From the Ashes / The Sign: the Di'Allas' energy manifests a recreation of Flint from Mack and Yo-Yo's fears.
